name: messages.list
description: List/search records without changing state. Archived or trashed records require explicit inclusion.

name: messages.get
description: Read one record and its revision/history metadata; no read flags are changed.

name: messages.conversation.create
description: Create a local conversation including the account owner and bound people.

name: messages.send
description: Append an outgoing message to a local conversation. Cross-App delivery is a separate explicit publish.

name: messages.edit
description: Edit an own, unretracted message and preserve prior text.

name: messages.retract
description: Retract an own message; retain history for inspection.

name: messages.mark_read
description: Explicitly mark one message read by the account owner. Reading is side-effect free.

name: messages.attachment.add
description: Attach verified bytes to an active record.

name: messages.attachment.read
description: Read an attachment only through its owning record.

name: messages.outbound
description: Build a CloudEvent from an own message without delivering it. Transport checks explicit recipient grants.
